summary: Re-ran live backend regression, public Expo mobile smoke, admin production build, lint, URL checks, and production configuration guard.

integration_issues.issue: https://pahel-foundation.preview.emergentagent.com/admin/ resolves to Expo Router Unmatched Route; the separately built admin panel is not accessible through the provided public preview URL.

action_items: Expose/deploy the functional admin bundle at a separately configured public route or URL, then re-test login and operational tables there.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend production guard correctly fails with valid URI syntax when required production settings are absent; an empty MONGO_URL fails earlier in the Mongo client constructor, but startup still fails closed.
No localhost fallback was found in admin source or frontend runtime source; admin/.env.example contains localhost only as a development example.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (mobile auth smoke, lint, Expo load); admin build 100%

seed_data_creation: Regression tests created temporary OTP users and SOS/donation records; no seeded admin or production records were modified intentionally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: APITXT reports sent in this environment. RAZORPAY, WhatsApp, Firebase/FCM and push delivery remain MOCKED/disabled without credentials. Expo public URL serves mobile app only; admin bundle needs its own accessible deployment URL.
rca_of_issue: The admin project builds successfully as a standalone Vite application, but the configured public preview is Expo Router and has no /admin route. Therefore /admin/ is handled by Expo and shows Unmatched Route rather than loading admin/index.html.
